welcome.title: Welcome to DQM Onboarding
welcome.intro: The National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN) uses <nhsnlink>NHSNLink</nhsnlink>, an open-source Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (<fhir>FHIR®</fhir>) application, to enable reporting of digital quality measures (dQMs) to NHSN. The enrollment information populated in this web form supports secure and successful authentication of NHSNLink with your facility’s FHIR endpoint, adequate understanding by NHSN of your FHIR data submissions, and successful reporting of dQMs to NHSN.
welcome.audienceBody: The onboarding steps that follow should be completed by the site’s information technology team.
welcome.workflowBody: Each onboarding section includes downloadable materials and instructions to facilitate completion. Onboarding steps do not have to be completed at one time; the user can save the information and return at a later time.
